harness_execution.name: Topological Network & Elevation Verification Harness
harness_execution.pass_criteria: All junctions snapped; DEM elevations interpolated; 25m transfer edges connect lift summits to trails.

content_harvesting.sublines: Directed Graph Compilation across 721 Ski Runs & 61 Lifts
talking_points: 225 DEM raster points and 32 surveyed USGS 3DEP benchmarks set elevations across 3457 junctions.
Downhill piste polarity (vertical_diff_m <= 0) and uphill lift polarity hold across all 3802 directed edges.
182 unload transfer edges (<= 25m, 30s base cost) link every lift top terminal into the trail network.
